name: user-simulation
description: Synthetic UX testing over a live web app with one command: say "user simulation" + a URL, answer 3 quick questions (test · inferred or own users · one screen or a flow) and get a one-page action summary — what to do, what we found, how users felt — linked to the full reports. Two lenses: EXPERIENCE (synthetic users walk the app: simulation-auto / simulation-run) and INSPECTION (expert Nielsen heuristic review: heuristic-test). No setup: uses the browser you already have (Claude desktop's built-in browser, Claude in Chrome, or Playwright MCP if present).
